what: Walk on east along the z=16 ford into unwritten (2,0), chapter 1's gate chunk; wait for the witness (up to 240 s); read the chunk: name, residents, props, words, lore, errand; the names in use it was given

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const p = S.useLandStore.getState().progress; return JSON.stringify({ episodes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(p?.episodes ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, { cleared: v.cleared, stage: v.stage ? v.stage.kind : null }])) }) })()
(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); return JSON.stringify({ chunk: S.useEngineStore.getState().chunk, c20: S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['2,0']?.status ?? 'absent' }) })()

repeat.until: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['2,0']; return c !== undefined && c.status !== 'writing' })()

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const c = S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['2,0']; const w = H.worldNow()?.chunks['2,0']; const lore = S.useLandStore.getState().lore.filter(n => n.coord.cx === 2 && n.coord.cz === 0); return JSON.stringify({ ms: Date.now() - window.__w1, status: c?.status, error: c?.status === 'failed' ? c.error : null, name: c?.scene?.name ?? null, residents: c?.scene?.npcs?.map(n => n.name + ' (' + n.role + ' @' + n.x + ',' + n.z + ')') ?? null, scene: w?.live.body.scene ?? null, dialogues: w?.live.body.dialogues ?? null, errands: w?.live.body.errands ?? null, lore: lore.map(n => n.kind + ': ' + n.label + ' — ' + n.text + ' [' + n.links.join(', ') + ']') }) })()
